# Oath Wallet — public documentation

Official product information only. Never submit recovery phrases, private keys, passcodes or wallet data to these interfaces.

Read-only MCP: https://oathwallet.org/mcp
Document index: https://oathwallet.org/agent-documents.json
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/oath-bitcoin-crypto-wallet/id6780187283
Public source and releases: https://github.com/devdasx/oath-wallet

Help instructions carry their applicable app version and authored update dates. Source excerpts cover 5.0.0 (102), reviewed 2026-11-02; this is not an independent audit or proof of App Store availability.

- [Bitcoin wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/bitcoin.md): Receive native BTC with your Oath address and review your Bitcoin network fee before sending.
- [Ethereum wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/ethereum.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Ethereum with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Solana wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/solana.md): Keep SOL and supported Solana tokens together, with receiving, sending and compatible dApp connections.
- [Gram wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/gram.md): Send and receive Gram on iPhone and iPad with Oath Wallet. Gram (GRAM) is the native coin of the TON blockchain, formerly called Toncoin.
- [THORChain wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/thorchain.md): Keep RUNE and supported THORChain assets in Oath, and connect to compatible THORChain dApps.
- [BNB Smart Chain wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/bnb-smart-chain.md): Receive, send and manage assets on BNB Smart Chain with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Polygon wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/polygon.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Polygon with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Arbitrum wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/arbitrum.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Arbitrum with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Base wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/base.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Base with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Optimism wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/optimism.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Optimism with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [Avalanche C-Chain wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/avalanche.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Avalanche C-Chain with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.
- [TRON wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/tron.md): Manage TRX and supported TRC-20 assets with clear send and receive details.
- [XRP Ledger wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/xrp-ledger.md): Receive XRP, manage supported XRP Ledger assets and review outgoing transfers in Oath.
- [NEAR Protocol wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/near.md): Receive NEAR and supported tokens, send from Oath and review compatible dApp requests.
- [Sui Network wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/sui.md): Manage SUI and supported Sui assets, with local transaction review and compatible dApp connections.
- [Aptos wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/aptos.md): Manage APT and supported Aptos assets in a native iPhone and iPad wallet.
- [Polkadot wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/polkadot.md): Manage DOT and supported Asset Hub assets in Oath on iPhone and iPad.
- [Stellar wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/stellar.md): Receive and send XLM and supported Stellar assets from Oath.
- [Litecoin wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/litecoin.md): Receive LTC, review activity and send Litecoin from your iPhone or iPad.
- [Dogecoin wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/dogecoin.md): Manage native DOGE with a clear receiving address and a fee review before you send.
- [Bitcoin Cash wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/bitcoin-cash.md): Send and receive BCH on Bitcoin Cash with a dedicated network account.
- [Arc wallet: send, receive and dApp connections](https://oathwallet.org/networks/arc.md): Receive, send and manage assets on Arc with Oath for iPhone and iPad. Keep your network, address and fee details in view.

- [Help Center](https://help.oathwallet.org/index.md)
- [Getting started](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/start.md): Your first wallet, without the guesswork.
- [Your wallets](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/wallets.md): Organize, personalize and manage your wallets.
- [Backup & recovery](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/backup.md): Keep a recovery route before you need it.
- [Security & privacy](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/security.md): Control access and protect sensitive information.
- [Assets & networks](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/assets.md): Understand balances, prices and tokens.
- [Send & receive](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/receive.md): Choose the right network, review a transfer and share an address.
- [Transactions & activity](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/activity.md): Read, check and share transaction information.
- [Settings & support](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/settings.md): Make Oath yours and find help.
- [dApps & permissions](https://help.oathwallet.org/collections/dapps.md): Connect apps, understand requests and revoke supported access.
- [Create your first wallet](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/create-wallet.md): Start with a new wallet, then give it a name and color you recognize.
- [Import a recovery phrase](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/import-recovery-phrase.md): Bring an existing wallet into Oath using supported BIP39, Electrum or aezeed recovery words and any required passphrase.
- [Scan a recovery-phrase QR code](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/scan-recovery-qr.md): Use the camera to import a compatible recovery phrase without typing every word.
- [Import a private key](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/import-private-key.md): Import the key for a particular network or the shared Ethereum & EVM group.
- [Which private-key formats can I import?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/private-key-formats.md): Choose the correct network before entering key material. Oath validates both format and key structure.
- [Set your first app passcode](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/first-passcode.md): Protect entry to Oath with the same six-digit keypad used to unlock it.
- [Find your way around Home](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/home-screen.md): Use the Wallet, History and Search icons, and find the controls for your active wallet.
- [Add another wallet](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/add-another-wallet.md): Keep separate wallets in the same app without replacing the one you already use.
- [Switch wallets from Home](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/switch-wallet.md): Use the glass name capsule above your balance to select another wallet or add one.
- [Change a wallet’s name and color](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/customize-wallet.md): Give each wallet a visual identity that is easy to recognize.
- [Reorder your wallets](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/reorder-wallets.md): Put frequently used wallets where you want them in the list.
- [Move a wallet to Recently Deleted](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/remove-wallet.md): Remove a wallet from the active list while keeping a short recovery window.
- [Recover a recently deleted wallet](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/recover-deleted-wallet.md): Bring a wallet back before its retention window expires.
- [Permanently delete removed wallets](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/permanently-delete-wallet.md): Clear wallets from Recently Deleted when you no longer need their local copies.
- [Create a wallet with a BIP-39 passphrase](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/add-passphrase.md): Derive a separate wallet from the same recovery phrase plus an exact passphrase.
- [Back up all wallets to iCloud](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/backup-all-wallets.md): Start an encrypted backup for every active wallet from one screen.
- [Back up one wallet to iCloud](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/backup-one-wallet.md): Create an encrypted recovery file for a particular wallet.
- [Understand your backup password](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/backup-password.md): The password for an iCloud backup is separate from your app passcode and BIP-39 passphrase.
- [Restore from an iCloud backup](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/restore-icloud.md): Recover a wallet from an encrypted Oath backup file.
- [Check whether a backup has finished](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/backup-status.md): Read the per-wallet result instead of assuming a switched-on toggle means success.
- [Fix an iCloud backup or restore problem](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/icloud-troubleshooting.md): Check the Apple Account, storage and backup file before retrying.
- [View your recovery phrase](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/view-recovery-phrase.md): Open the recovery words for a phrase-based wallet when you need an offline backup.
- [View or copy a private key](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/view-private-key.md): Reveal the recovery key for a selected account only when you need it.
- [Restore your wallets on another iPhone](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/move-to-new-phone.md): Use recovery material or an encrypted iCloud backup before removing the old installation.
- [Unlock Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/unlock-wallet.md): Use your app passcode or enabled biometrics to open the app.
- [Enable passcode protection](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/enable-passcode.md): Require authentication to enter Oath.
- [Change your app passcode](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/change-passcode.md): Replace your Oath unlock code without changing your wallet addresses.
- [Enable Face ID or Touch ID](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/enable-face-id.md): Use the device’s biometric authentication for faster access.
- [Turn off Face ID or passcode protection](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/disable-security.md): Change how Oath authenticates you from the security screen.
- [Choose when Oath locks](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/auto-lock.md): Control how long Oath stays unlocked after moving to the background.
- [Lock Oath immediately](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/lock-now.md): End the current unlocked session without waiting for the automatic delay.
- [Hide the app preview in the app switcher](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/app-switcher-privacy.md): Cover the app’s preview when switching between apps.
- [Hide balances on screen](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/hide-balances.md): Temporarily replace visible amounts with dots.
- [What if I forget my app passcode?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/forgot-passcode.md): Keep recovery options separate from the app lock.
- [Reset Oath on this device](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/reset-app.md): Erase local app data and return to setup.
- [Open an asset’s screen](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/asset-screen.md): View one asset’s value, quantity, market information and activity.
- [Understand balances and portfolio value](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/portfolio-values.md): Oath shows token quantities and a local-currency valuation.
- [Refresh balances and activity](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/refresh-balances.md): Request updated data without leaving your wallet.
- [Search for a coin or token](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/search-assets.md): Find an asset by its name, symbol, network or saved token address.
- [Find and add a token by address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/add-custom-token.md): Look up a supported contract or mint address and review its details before adding it.
- [Why isn’t a token appearing?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/token-not-found.md): Check the wallet, network, address and lookup result before assuming funds are missing.
- [How assets are sorted](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/asset-order.md): The list prioritizes portfolio value instead of alphabetical order alone.
- [Read an asset’s price and chart](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/prices-chart.md): View the latest available market quote and its recent movement.
- [View an asset’s information](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/asset-information.md): Check the network, symbol, type and token identity.
- [Why does my address need funds to activate?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/account-activation-and-reserves.md): Understand account activation, minimum balances and storage on Stellar, XRP Ledger, Solana, TRON, NEAR and Gram (TON). Oath does not charge an activation fee.
- [Receive crypto with a QR code](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/receive-crypto.md): Share the receiving address for the wallet and network you intend to use.
- [Copy or share your receiving address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/copy-share-address.md): Use Oath’s receive actions instead of retyping a long address.
- [What does “and more” mean on Receive?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/receive-network-tokens.md): The example logos illustrate tokens on a network; they are not a limit on what its address can receive.
- [Choose a Bitcoin address type](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/bitcoin-address-types.md): Select the receiving format compatible with the service sending you BTC.
- [Why can a Bitcoin receiving address change?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/bitcoin-gap-limit.md): HD wallets derive multiple addresses rather than reusing one address forever.
- [Choose Phantom or Trust Wallet’s Solana path](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/solana-address-path.md): Match the Solana account derived by the wallet you are recovering.
- [Check the network before a transfer](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/wrong-network.md): Prevent address and network mismatches before the sender broadcasts.
- [Read your transaction activity](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/transaction-list.md): See the direction, time and amount for an asset’s transactions.
- [Open transaction details](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/transaction-details.md): Review the useful details without navigating raw blockchain data.
- [Understand pending, confirmed and failed activity](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/transaction-status.md): Use status to distinguish a submitted transaction from a settled one.
- [What do Canceled and Replaced mean?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/canceled-replaced.md): These labels are shown only when the app has evidence of the corresponding transaction state.
- [Read the network fee](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/network-fee.md): See a transaction’s available fee converted to your chosen currency.
- [Copy a transaction ID or address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/copy-transaction-id.md): Use the small copy controls beside shortened identifiers.
- [View a transaction on its explorer](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/view-explorer.md): Open the public network record inside Oath’s native browser.
- [Share a transaction image or link](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/share-transaction.md): Export a receipt-style image or a link to the explorer.
- [Send coins and tokens](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/send-availability.md): Choose the right wallet, network, recipient and amount, then review and authorize a transfer.
- [Create a contact in the address book](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/address-book.md): Save a person’s name first, then add network-specific addresses.
- [Add an address to a contact](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/contact-address.md): Associate a public address with the correct network.
- [Edit a contact or saved address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/edit-contact.md): Keep contact names, address labels and network entries up to date.
- [Delete a contact or remove an address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/delete-contact.md): Clear address-book entries you no longer need.
- [Find a contact](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/search-contacts.md): Search the saved address book before opening a contact’s details.
- [Change your display currency](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/currency.md): Show portfolio values, prices and available fees in your preferred local currency.
- [Change the app language](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/language.md): Choose an available language for Oath’s interface.
- [Use Light, Dark or System appearance](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/appearance.md): Choose a fixed appearance or follow the device’s setting.
- [Change the app icon](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/app-icon.md): Choose an Oath icon from the available alternatives.
- [Review wallet permissions and connected apps](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/permissions.md): Inspect token allowances, NFT access, connected apps and supported account-control permissions for the selected wallet.
- [Open links without leaving Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/in-app-browser.md): Websites and explorer links open in a native iOS browser inside the app.
- [Request a feature](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/request-feature.md): Suggest a specific improvement and explain how it would help.
- [Report a bug](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/report-bug.md): Give enough detail for the problem to be reproduced without exposing secrets.
- [Contact Oath support](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/contact-support.md): Email the team at care@oathwallet.org.
- [Find articles, privacy and terms](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/about-legal.md): Open Oath’s published information from the About screen.
- [Use Bitcoin Cash in Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/use-bitcoin-cash.md): Receive, send and inspect Bitcoin Cash assets using the correct account and network.

- [Use Ethereum and EVM networks](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/evm-networks.md): One wallet can show the same public address across EVM networks while tracking each network separately.
- [Understand USDC on Arc](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/arc-usdc.md): Arc uses USDC as its native asset in the app’s network integration.
- [Use Robinhood Chain](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/robinhood-chain.md): Find the Robinhood Chain account separately from an exchange account or other EVM networks.
- [Scan a token address from Home](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/home-scanner.md): Use the viewfinder button to bring QR text into asset search without typing it.
- [Open the current wallet’s settings from Home](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/wallet-settings-shortcut.md): Reach the active wallet’s management screen using the toolbar shortcut that appears after scrolling.
- [Read wallet balances and the active-wallet badge](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/wallet-balances.md): Recognize each wallet by its color and check its available value beside the disclosure arrow.
- [View the active wallet’s full transaction history](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/full-transaction-history.md): Review available coin and token activity together across the active wallet’s networks.
- [Search transactions by ID, address or amount](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/search-transactions.md): Find a transaction using information you already know, within the active wallet’s available history.
- [Filter transaction history](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/filter-transactions.md): Narrow activity by network, asset, direction, status, date and quantity without changing the underlying records.
- [View all transactions for one coin or token](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/asset-transaction-history.md): Move from an asset’s five-entry preview to a dedicated history for that exact asset and account.
- [How Oath hides spam and phishing activity](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/spam-history.md): Understand why suspicious or unverified token entries can be absent from your activity lists.
- [Why can a transaction show zero?](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/zero-value-transactions.md): Distinguish a rounded fiat amount, a zero-value contract action and a hidden spam transfer.
- [Understand verified and manually added tokens](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/unverified-tokens.md): Learn why automatic discovery can omit a token and what changes when you choose to track it.
- [Use the checkmark to finish an action](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/confirmation-checkmark.md): The native checkmark replaces text Done controls in supported screens and sheets.
- [Authenticate before opening Passcode & Face ID](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/security-settings-access.md): Protect changes to app security with a separate authentication step.
- [Open and search the Help Center](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/help-center.md): Find a feature’s instructions inside Oath and return to the app when you are finished.
- [Use Max and understand spendable balance](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/send-max-and-fees.md): See why the maximum you can send may be lower than the total displayed on Home.
- [Enter destination tags and memos](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/send-tags-and-memos.md): Include the extra reference an exchange or shared receiving account needs to credit your transfer.
- [Set Bitcoin transfer options](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/bitcoin-transfer-options.md): Understand Replace by fee and the optional public on-chain message before sending.
- [Resolve a transfer that cannot be sent](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/send-troubleshooting.md): Work out whether the problem is validation, fees, authorization, provider access or an uncertain submission.
- [Connect a dApp with WalletConnect](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/connect-dapp.md): Approve the intended website, wallet and networks before responding to a dApp request.
- [Disconnect a dApp safely](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/dapp-disconnect.md): End a WalletConnect session and separately review any on-chain permissions you granted.
- [Review a token swap from a dApp](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/dapp-swap.md): Understand which asset you pay, which asset you expect, and the network and limits you are authorizing.
- [Read human-readable transaction data](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/dapp-transaction-data.md): Use the decoded details to understand a contract request while keeping the exact technical payload available.
- [Review messages, sign-ins and token permits](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/dapp-signatures.md): Tell a login challenge apart from a message, token approval or spending authorization.
- [Use Solana dApps and test networks](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/walletconnect-solana.md): Review Solana requests on the exact mainnet, Devnet or Testnet cluster approved for the session.
- [Review THORChain dApp requests](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/walletconnect-thorchain.md): Check RUNE transfers, deposits and readable cross-chain swap instructions separately.
- [Revoke a token allowance or delegate](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/revoke-token-access.md): Remove a supported permission and verify that access is actually gone on-chain.
- [Revoke several permissions](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/bulk-revoke-access.md): Select a group of permissions, review the batch and check each result independently.
- [Understand permission scan coverage](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/permission-coverage.md): Use scan status to distinguish checked, partial, unavailable and unindexed network results.
- [Check a contract and approved address](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/check-contract-access.md): Look up a specific supported permission when you know the exact contract and spender.
- [Understand Permit2 and signed approvals](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/permit2-access.md): Separate an existing allowance from a signature that may authorize future spending.
- [Check revocation progress and failures](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/permission-removal-history.md): Confirm each permission removal rather than assuming a completed queue means every item succeeded.
- [Review account-control and permanent delegates](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/account-control-permissions.md): Recognize permissions that affect more than a single token allowance.
- [Remove the last active wallet](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/last-wallet-reset.md): Understand the final-wallet reset and clear Recently Deleted only after protecting your recovery options.
- [Open existing wallets after an Oath update](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/upgrade-existing-wallets.md): Unlock normally and let Oath prepare compatible existing wallets without creating replacements.
- [Understand the balance-change capsule](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/balance-change.md): Read the observed change under the portfolio total without mistaking deposits for investment profit.
- [Filter the Home assets list](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/asset-filters.md): Narrow the portfolio by network and available asset filters without changing ownership.
- [Understand token logos and missing prices](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/token-prices-and-logos.md): Distinguish token identity, balance, artwork and market data when searching by contract or mint.
- [Turn haptic feedback on or off](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/haptic-feedback.md): Choose whether Oath provides tactile feedback for supported controls and outcomes.
- [Use THORChain and RUNE](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/use-thorchain.md): Receive RUNE, send on THORChain and distinguish a direct transfer from a dApp swap.
- [Use HyperEVM in Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/use-hyperevm.md): Find the correct HyperEVM account, native fee asset and tokens without confusing other EVM deployments.
- [Use Monad in Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/use-monad.md): Find the correct Monad account, native fee asset and tokens without confusing other EVM deployments.
- [Use Unichain in Oath](https://help.oathwallet.org/articles/use-unichain.md): Find the correct Unichain account, native fee asset and tokens without confusing other EVM deployments.
